takeaway: The desktop app runs as a Swing process in a Java 23 JVM on the user's workstation and talks over JDBC/TCP port 3306 (Hibernate + MySQL Connector/J) to a MySQL server holding schema reports_db, which defaults to the same machine (127.0.0.1).

elements.name: User workstation (citizen or municipal operator)
elements.responsibility: Machine running the Swing desktop client

elements.name: Java 23 runtime (JVM)
elements.responsibility: Execution environment; no executable jar, launched with dependency classpath and main class Boundary.HomePageGUI

elements.name: municipal-report-management-1.0-SNAPSHOT (no executable jar)
elements.responsibility: Application artifact with Swing GUI, controllers, entities and persistence support; entry points are main methods of the GUI classes

elements.name: persistence.xml (packaged with the app)
elements.responsibility: Deployment specification: driver, JDBC URL, user, plaintext password, hbm2ddl update; classpath resource inside the app

elements.name: Hibernate ORM 6.6, MySQL Connector/J 9.4, forms_rt 7.0.3
elements.responsibility: Runtime libraries: JPA provider, JDBC driver, GUI Designer layout runtime used by the Swing forms

elements.name: Database host (same machine by default)
elements.responsibility: Machine hosting MySQL; URL 127.0.0.1 and grant @localhost make it co-located by default

elements.name: Schema reports_db (user reports_user)
elements.responsibility: Stores users, reports, notes, status updates, notifications
